<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

A downstream consumer is shipping harness to production and is blocked by 134 test failures across 32 files on Windows. This plan carries the two failure classes that are NOT Windows bugs — undeclared external binaries (class 3) and load-sensitive contention (class 4) — while pij-spiritual-turkey carries the path-separator and symlink-privilege classes.

The split exists because a windows-latest CI leg would surface classes 3 and 4 as WINDOWS failures. That is the right symptom with the wrong diagnosis attached, and it ends with someone platform-guarding a real cross-platform bug. Both classes bite a Linux dev box too.

Delivery is an ITERATION LOOP, not a merge: PR #118 stays open, the consumer pulls the branch, runs, and reports; each round becomes a commit. Scope for each round is set by THEIR ranking of what blocks them, not by our reading of which file has the most failures.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Remove failures from the consumer's run in small consumable rounds, ranked by what blocks THEM — turnaround beats scope while they are blocked in production.
- Never claim more than is measured: report FAILURES FIXED, FAILURES DECLARED and SKIPS RECOVERED as three separate numbers, so a declared skip is never read as coverage.
- Where an external binary is the test's SUBJECT rather than its mechanism, declare it loudly rather than rewriting it — a rewrite would keep the test green while destroying what it proves.
- Keep the branch current with main so the consumer is never testing against a stale base.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Classes 1 and 2 (path separators, symlink privilege) — pij-spiritual-turkey's ground. Their work lands on THIS branch by prime's ruling, but this seat does not recruit their commits.
- Arming the windows-latest CI leg — approved with conditions but bound to turkey's PR, and its billing must change first (see ac-0005).
- services/doctor/collector/nudge.test.ts — 40 failures, the largest single file and 30% of all Windows failures, in no class and no brief. Recorded and routed to Jordan, deliberately not absorbed here.
- Merging PR #118. It is the consumer's iteration branch and stays open by design.
- Reproducing the consumer's environment in CI. A hosted runner is curated and cannot stand in for their box — proven, not assumed (ac-0005).
